notes: Caltech alumni news items (7) and the CMU undergraduate AP-credit page are not lists. The Weatherhead honor roll is a donor list, not a placement page: it names doctoral alumni with degree years only and mixes PhD (GRS) with Doctor of Management (MGT) graduates from all Weatherhead areas; it has no dissertation or placement data, so it is useful mainly to confirm graduation years for Operations Research/Management PhDs (for example Evan L. Porteus GRS '67, Kamlesh Mathur GRS '80). The Columbia dissertation pages (index plus ?year=1998..2012) are a cross-area dissertation list (author, year, advisor, abstract) and need area classification by advisor/topic; they give degree years but no placements. Most Columbia year pages show exactly 10 entries and the text shows no pagination control, so the saved captures may be truncated to the first 10 dissertations of the year; the live page (or ?page= variants) should be checked before treating any year as complete. The index candidate's saved text is a print-layout variant of the page (layout=cbs_print, main.id=10323) that shows the 2016 list, not necessarily what the bare URL served. Institutions by host are correct for every page.
